destinations.name: Pink City Heritage
destinations.description: Explore sandstone palaces, vibrant bazaars and the architectural stories of Rajasthan.

destinations.name: Backwater Escape
destinations.description: Slow down beside palm-lined canals and discover the landscapes of Kerala.

destinations.name: Himalayan Trails
destinations.description: Discover mountain paths, cedar forests and dramatic valley views with a local guide.

destinations.name: Old City Food Walk
destinations.description: Taste regional specialties and discover the streets and stories of Old Delhi.

destinations.name: Coastal Discovery
destinations.description: Explore coastal villages, peaceful beaches and the distinctive heritage of Goa.

destinations.name: Lakeside Stories
destinations.description: Discover lakeside architecture, traditional craft and the history of the City of Lakes.

destinations.name: Ganga Sunrise Walk
destinations.description: Walk the riverside lanes at sunrise and hear local stories of music, craft and daily life.

destinations.name: Tea Garden Getaway
destinations.description: Wander through rolling tea country, visit a local tea stop and enjoy misty hill views.

destinations.name: Desert Dunes Evening
destinations.description: Explore desert landscapes with a local guide and enjoy an evening of regional storytelling.

destinations.name: French Quarter Stroll
destinations.description: Discover colourful streets, coastal architecture and the layered history of the French Quarter.

destinations.name: Temple Town Flavours
destinations.description: Explore busy market streets and sample a fictional tasting itinerary inspired by Tamil cuisine.

destinations.name: Island Shoreline Trail
destinations.description: Enjoy a gentle shoreline discovery walk, coastal viewpoints and stories of island life.
